name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new skill, output style, or improvement to an existing one
labels: enhancement
---

**Before you open your issue:**
* All issues and contributions are covered by the [Code of Conduct](/.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
* Please check out the [Contribution guidelines](/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)

## User story

**As a** <role>,
**I want** <capability>,
**so that** <outcome>.

## Problem

A clear and concise description of the gap in the current workflow. Ex. There's no skill that handles [...], or [skill] doesn't cover [...].

## Proposal

A clear and concise description of the new skill, output style, or change you want, and any alternative approaches or existing skills that partially cover this. If this is a new skill, note whether it's language-agnostic or needs R/Python-specific counterparts.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] <falsifiable criterion>

## Additional context

Add any other context here — related skills, `_partials`/`_docs` that might need updating, or links to relevant issues.
